name: comment-hygiene
description: Enforce consistent comment style as the agent writes code — one-line comments stay one line, template/HTML comments never leak into the DOM, and every method/class you write gets a doc comment (JSDoc, Javadoc, C# XML doc, docstring, godoc, rustdoc, YARD, PHPDoc, GDScript ##) with the right params/return/purpose — never backfilling docs on existing code unless asked.
